column1: Traffic reports will resume on Wednesday, Aug. 20 at 4 p.m.

column3: TRAFFIC ALERT FOR I-75S AT THE SOUTHERN SPLIT:
column4: Crews continue working to remove a double-trailer semi that was on its side due to an earlier collision .  I-75S is down to one lane (the right lane is open) until further notice.  Traffic is backed up to toward Newtown Pike.

column3: TRAFFIC ALERT FOR I-75S AT THE SOUTHERN SPLIT:
column4: NOTE:  Police units remain on the shoulder on the northbound side.  Use added caution.
